title: Adventure Rooms
specs: Canada's first escape room game 'The Original Adventure' in Kitchener
Escape rooms designed for 20-30% success rate
Suitable for children 8 years and up to play without adults
Children 6 and up pay regular price; children 5 and under free
Tournament and duel formats available for 8-24 players or more
includes: Private event for you and your guests only
Reception available 5 minutes prior to game time
gap: Minimum age not explicitly stated for all games
blurb: Guests solve puzzles and use skill and cunning to escape locked rooms before a countdown reaches zero. Games are private events for groups of 2-24 players, with various durations and difficulty levels designed for a 20-30% success rate. Suitable for birthdays, corporate team-building, student learning, and more.
extraNote: Advance reservations required · Doors locked between and during appointments · $15/half hour + HST for party room rental in Kitchener · No alcohol allowed; family-friendly and non-licensed · Ground floor at 283 Duke Street West, Kitchener, ON Unit #102. Use the building’s main glass entrance off Duke St. W. First big red door on the right inside the main lobby.
